mutations.name: ignore-actual-attachment
mutations.why: An actual attachment is treated as a new child, changing custody and enabling setup-failure cleanup.

mutations.name: start-another-execution
mutations.why: Reopen starts a second execution instead of attaching the retained one.

mutations.name: apply-old-list-absence
mutations.why: A stale read, including one that lists retired A but not B, removes B after its await.

mutations.name: old-close-ack-deletes-runtime
mutations.why: An old close acknowledgment deletes B's renderer runtime.

mutations.name: old-rollback-continuation
mutations.why: A failed A close resumes its held reconcile after B's close starts, overwriting B's serial and deleting B's runtime.

mutations.name: accept-old-starting-frame
mutations.why: A starting frame from A resets B's work state.
